#!/usr/bin/env python3
# check_report.py -- mechanical consistency check: every value in the
# hand-written rederivation-report.yaml equals the raw output of blind_j6.py.
import sys, json, yaml
from collections import Counter

report_path, stdout_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
rep = yaml.safe_load(open(report_path))["rederivation_report"]
res = json.loads(open(stdout_path).read().split("=== RESULTS JSON ===\n", 1)[1])
fails, n_ok = [], 0


def eq(tag, a, b):
    global n_ok
    if a == b:
        n_ok += 1
    else:
        fails.append((tag, a, b))


# ---- Q1 ----
raw_q1 = {(r["q"], r["n"]): r for r in res["Q1"]}
eq("Q1 instance set", sorted((c["q"], c["n"]) for c in rep["Q1"]["results"]), sorted(raw_q1))
for c in rep["Q1"]["results"]:
    r = raw_q1[(c["q"], c["n"])]
    tag = "Q1(%d,%d)" % (c["q"], c["n"])
    eq(tag + " count", c["count"], r["count"])
    eq(tag + " dimensions", c["dimensions"], r["dimensions"])
    eq(tag + " d_min", c["d_min"], r["d_min"])
    eq(tag + " ord", c["ord_n_q"], r["order_formula"]["ord_n_q_own"])
    cnt = Counter(r["factor_degrees"])
    big = [d for d in cnt if d != 1]
    eq(tag + " factor_degrees", c["factor_degrees"], "1 + %dx%d" % (cnt[big[0]], big[0]) if len(big) == 1 and cnt[1] == 1 else None)
    fm = r["field_model"].replace("[2]*t", "2t").replace("t + [2]", "t + a").replace("a^2+a+1", "a^2 + a + 1").replace("a^3+a+1", "a^3 + a + 1")
    eq(tag + " field_model", c["field_model"], fm)
    eq(tag + " faithful = dims minus {0,1}", r["faithful_dimensions"], [d for d in r["dimensions"] if d not in (0, 1)])

# ---- Q2 ----
raw_q2 = {(c["n"], c["m"]): c for c in res["Q2"]}
eq("Q2 cell set", sorted((c["n"], c["m"]) for c in rep["Q2"]["cells"]), sorted(raw_q2))
for c in rep["Q2"]["cells"]:
    r = raw_q2[(c["n"], c["m"])]
    tag = "Q2(%d,%d)" % (c["n"], c["m"])
    for k in ["l_star", "l_prime", "penalty", "margin_bits", "verdict"]:
        eq(tag + " " + k, c[k], r[k])

# ---- Q3 ----
raw_q3 = res["Q3"]["per_n"]
s = res["Q3"]["s_k_alpha_pow_k_plus_beta_pow_k"]
eq("Q3 n set", sorted(str(c["n"]) for c in rep["Q3"]["results"]), sorted(raw_q3))
for c in rep["Q3"]["results"]:
    n = c["n"]
    a, b = raw_q3[str(n)]["model_A"], raw_q3[str(n)]["model_B"]
    tag = "Q3(n=%d)" % n
    for k in ["F_V_size", "f", "orbits", "ratio", "group_order"]:
        eq(tag + " " + k, c[k], a[k])
        eq(tag + " " + k + " modelB", c[k], b[k])
    eq(tag + " hist", {str(k): v for k, v in c["orbit_length_histogram"].items()}, a["orbit_length_histogram"])
    eq(tag + " ratio_exact", str(c["ratio_exact"]), a["ratio_fraction"])
    eq(tag + " field_models", c["field_models"], [a["field_model"], b["field_model"]])
    x = c["crosschecks"]
    eq(tag + " affine", x["affine_points"], a["method_A_exhaustive_affine_points"])
    eq(tag + " K", x["kloosterman_sum_K"], a["kloosterman_sum_K"])
    eq(tag + " s_n", x["s_n"], s[n])
    eq(tag + " closed form", x["closed_form_F_V_size"], raw_q3[str(n)]["method_D_closed_form_F_V_size_1+(2^n-3-s_n)/2"])
    eq(tag + " rational pts", x["F_2_rational_points_in_F_V"], ["(%d,%d)" % tuple(p) for p in a["F_V_points_with_both_coords_in_F2"]])

# ---- environment / bookkeeping ----
env = rep["environment"]
eq("internal checks run", env["internal_checks"]["run"], res["internal_checks"]["n_checks"])
eq("internal checks failed", env["internal_checks"]["failed"], len(res["internal_checks"]["failed"]))
eq("wall", env["resources"]["wall_clock_seconds"], res["total_seconds"])
eq("cpu", env["resources"]["cpu_user_seconds"], res["cpu_user_seconds"])
eq("rss", env["resources"]["peak_rss_kib"], res["peak_rss_kib"])
eq("attestation joints", rep["review_attestation"]["joints_owned"], ["J6"])
eq("attestation sibling", rep["review_attestation"]["read_sibling_reports"], False)
eq("attestation blind", rep["review_attestation"]["blind_from_respected"], True)
eq("attestation fallback", rep["review_attestation"]["inference"]["fallback_used"], True)

print("comparisons_passed:", n_ok)
print("comparisons_failed:", len(fails))
for f in fails:
    print("  FAIL", f)
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
